question: Which customer has the highest average monthly change in payment amounts? Provide the customer's full name.
sql:
-- Full query to find the customer with the highest average monthly change
WITH monthly_payments AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    date_trunc('month', payment_date) as payment_month,
    SUM(amount) as total_amount
  FROM payment
  GROUP BY customer_id, date_trunc('month', payment_date)
),
with_lag AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    payment_month,
    total_amount,
    LAG(total_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_month) as prev_amount
  FROM monthly_payments
),
changes AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    payment_month,
    total_amount,
    prev_amount,
    total_amount - prev_amount as monthly_change
  FROM with_lag
  WHERE prev_amount IS NOT NULL
),
avg_changes AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    AVG(monthly_change) as avg_monthly_change
  FROM changes
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT 
  ac.customer_id,
  c.first_name,
  c.last_name,
  ac.avg_monthly_change
FROM avg_changes ac
JOIN customer c ON ac.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY ac.avg_monthly_change DESC
LIMIT 1
